study: Free-text paraphrases and one-detail counterfactuals on four released UAE street scenes
scope: The four photos, previous misses and the independent first-cohort reference regions were already known. These twelve utterances are fixed before the 35B release or any run of them. This tests wording conditional on known photographs and does not measure new-scene generalisation. Nothing from the separate seven-scene cohort is used.
source_credit: Grab and KartaView contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0
comparison: Two meaning-equivalent requests for the original point per scene. C changes only one colour word in A and must not present the original point as a match. A factual clarification asking about the different referent is reported separately from a source-supported direct answer.
procedure: Use a fresh normal typed session on canonical 8775 for every utterance in locked mixed order, selected public recording and frame with original hash verified. No manual marking, choice or confirmation. Score point-in-original-reference and distinguish single direct proposal, matching-only options, wrong options, no-pin clarification, operational error and delayed response. Mixed matching and wrong options are never a direct correct proposal. For a contradiction, a pin or selectable unsupported point is a false offer. A completed refusal or clarification with no options is a pass, and an operational timeout is unscored separately. Record time to terminal response at 15 s and observe to 45 s. Derive source/actor and candidate counts from the ordinary journal, and distinguish absence of a geometrically valid proposal from wording/evidence rejection when the records support it.
